description: Control the Head module (pan servo, needs set_module head first). angle_deg turns the face to −90…90° relative to the body (+ = right, servo ≈180°/s) and switches to manual. track_light=true makes the head find and follow the light with its own light sensors: it sweeps the full range, settles on the brightest angle and keeps hill-climbing (rescans if the light is lost). Light sensors are directional (brightest when facing the lamp) and ride on the head. Starts the simulation.
name: set_head
title: Turn the head
